steps.speaker: Garrick
steps.title: The Forge
steps.body:
My main work is unlocking recipes. Bring me materials from the dungeon and I'll add new items to the Shop's inventory — the more recipes you unlock, the better gear Pemberton can stock.

But if you need something specific and don't want to leave it to chance, I also take craft requests. Bring the materials and pay double the item's value in gold, and I'll hammer it out for you on the spot.

steps.speaker: Garrick
steps.title: Tiers and Specialties
steps.body:
Upgrade my facility with gold and materials to unlock higher-tier recipes. Better tools on the anvil means finer work — a Tier 1 forge hammers out basics, but a Tier 4 forge has the precision to craft masterwork gear.

The Huntsman handles bows, leather, and backpacks. The Enchanter handles staves, focuses, and rings. Each of us has our specialty — check in after every run to see what's new.

steps.speaker: Garrick
steps.title: Quality Matters
steps.body:
Higher facility tiers also improve the quality of items sold in the Shop. At Tier 1 everything's Common, but upgrade to Tier 2 and you'll start seeing Uncommon and Rare gear on the shelves.

Reach Tier 4 and there's even a chance of Epic equipment. Quality applies to craft requests too — a better forge means finer custom work. Better tools make better heroes.
